cohorts.prospective: frozen first-960 ordering, current outcome-blind prefix only
cohorts.v11: published b0 train, frozen, and extension sibling pairs

lineage_nondegeneracy_rule: A cohort is non-degenerate only if at least one scoped sibling pair differs in op, depth, step, or n_siblings. Task, physical run, and parent are fixed by the sibling estimand.
literal_transfer_rule: Literal FLORA/Agentic-Predictor transfer requires every required semantic to be directly represented for every scoped endpoint; a search-lineage edge, operator name, task slug, or monolithic candidate program is not silently relabeled as an internal workflow DAG, operator implementation, natural-language task, or workflow implementation.

status_rules.baseline_omission_rationale_supported: literal transfer is unsupported and the prospective lineage-only adaptation is pair-invariant
status_rules.future_adapted_baseline: Any AST/token graph plus search-context multi-view scorer is a new representation and may only be frozen for an outcome-unread extension or a future cohort
